text: Sorry to message so late, I know you must be really busy and this is probably nothing, so please deal with the urgent ones first. I've got my nephew staying with me, he's 4. This evening he got a temperature and it's 38.9 now. He's had a runny nose all day, it's been running then blocked, and he keeps sneezing. About an hour ago I noticed some red blotchy bits on his tummy and back. I'd read you're meant to do the glass test, so I pressed a glass on them and they went pale and disappeared under it. I did it a few times to make sure and they faded every time. I think that's the good sign? I just don't have kids myself and I don't want to get it wrong while he's in my care. His mum is on a night shift and I didn't want to worry her for nothing. Sorry again, I really appreciate whoever reads this.
